original: nanvevamapi niviśate ityādau tayoḥ samāsāpattistayormithaḥ sambandhamupajīvyaivātmanepadavidhānena tatastasya pūrvamāvaśyakatvādata āha - nerviśa iti| ādinā " parivyavebhyaḥ" , " viparābhyāṃ jeḥ" ityādiparigrahaḥ| yadyapyatra ṣaṣṭhyā nidyotyārthaviśeṣārthapratipādakādityarthena nirvāhastathāpyagrimasūtrānurodhenāha - neḥ paratveneti|
analyzed: nanu evam api niviśate ityādau tayoḥ samāsa āpattiḥ tayoḥ mithas sambandham upajīvya eva ātmanepada vidhānena tatas tasya pūrvam āvaśyaka tvāt atas āha neḥ viśaḥ iti ādinā pari vi avebhyaḥ vi parābhyām jeḥ ityādi parigrahaḥ yadi api atra ṣaṣṭhyā nidyotya artha viśeṣa artha pratipādakāt iti arthena nirvāhaḥ tathā api agrima sūtra anurodhena āha neḥ paratvena iti

original: - ityarthaḥ-- krameṇetyādyarthaḥ| tathāca tatsambandhātpūrvamevātmanepadapravṛttiriti na doṣaḥ| tatra ṣaṣṭhyarthe pañcamīkalpane tu gāravam| spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ " nerviśa" ityatra bhāṣye| etena suṭo'pi saṃparibhyāmupasṛṣṭasyetyarthena, tābhyāṃ paratvayogyasyetyarthena vā samo yogātpūrvameva suḍityevamantaraṅgatvaṃ sūcitam|
analyzed: iti arthaḥ krameṇa ityādi arthaḥ tathā ca tad sambandhāt pūrvam eva ātmanepada pravṛttiḥ iti na doṣaḥ tatra ṣaṣṭhī arthe pañcamī kalpane tu gāravam spaṣṭam ca idam neḥ viśaḥ iti atra bhāṣye etena suṭaḥ upi sam paribhyām upasṛṣṭasya iti arthena tābhyām paratva yogyasya iti arthena vā samaḥ yogāt pūrvam eva suṭ iti evam antaraṅga tvam sūcitam

original: nanvevamapi vibhaktyabhāvena samudāyoccāraṇena vidheḥ samparkotyādau tayoḥ samāsāpattirata āha - saṃpṛcetyāderapīti| uktabhāṣyāvirodhāyoktarītyā sūtre dvayoranukaraṇena ṣaṣṭhīsamāsa iti bhāvaḥ| āyatastūḥ kaṭaprūrajasrapamityādau tathā satve'pi dhātūpasargayoḥ kvāpi sa neti tātparyam|
analyzed: nanu evam api vibhakti abhāvena samudāya uccāraṇena vidheḥ tayoḥ samāsa āpattiḥ atas āha saṃpṛca ityādeḥ api iti ukta bhāṣya avirodhāya ukta rītyā sūtre dvayoḥ anukaraṇena ṣaṣṭhī samāsaḥ iti bhāvaḥ āyataḥ tūḥ kaṭa prūḥ aja srapam ityādau tathā sattve api dhātu upasargayoḥ kvāpi sa na iti tātparyam

original: uktarītyā " saṃprasāraṇācca "iti bhāṣyarītyā ceṣṭamapi siddhānte sidhyatītyāha - gosandāya iti| - viśiṣṭāt-- tadviśiṣṭārthapratipādikāt| pūrvamasambandhāyāha - buddhistheiti| īdṛśe sthale'yameva sādhutvānvākhyānaprakāra iti sarvatātparyam| evaṃ harisaṃmatabhāṣyasiddhānte harivirodhaṃ haryuktyaiva pariharati- yadyapītyādinā siddhāntitamityantena|
analyzed: ukta rītyā saṃprasāraṇāt ca iti bhāṣya rītyā ca iṣṭam api siddhānte sidhyati iti āha gosandāya iti viśiṣṭāt tad viśiṣṭa artha pratipādikāt pūrvam asambandhāya āha buddhi sthā iti īdṛśe sthalā iyam eva sādhutva anvākhyāna prakāraḥ iti sarva tātparyam evam hari saṃmata bhāṣya siddhānte hari virodham hari uktyā eva pariharati yadi api ityādinā siddhāntitam ityantena

original: tattvasya spaṣṭatvādvācakamātrodāharaṇamāha - yathāpratiṣṭhate iti| bhūvādisūtrabhāṣyoktameva| - tiṣṭhateriti| sthādhātorityarthaḥ| - ityarthikayā-- ititātparyikayā|cetanaviśiṣṭairgamyata ityasya samuccayaḥ| evamanvayavyatirekayoḥ sattve'pi na vācakatvaṃ tayordyotakatayaivopapatterityāha - tatra-- tatpratītiviṣaye ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tattvasya spaṣṭa tvāt vācaka mātra udāharaṇam āha yathā pratiṣṭhate iti bhūvādi sūtra bhāṣya uktam eva tiṣṭhateḥ iti sthā dhātoḥ iti arthaḥ iti arthikayā iti tātparyikayā acetana viśiṣṭaiḥ gamyate iti asya samuccayaḥ evam anvaya vyatirekayoḥ sattve api na vācaka tvam tayoḥ dyotaka tayā eva upapatteḥ iti āha tatra tad pratīti viṣaye iti arthaḥ

original: - dvividhāt-- anvayavyatirekiṇaḥ| pūrvoktamīdṛśameva| prādirupasarga evetyāha - kvaciditi| - bhedāḥ-- viśeṣāḥ prakarṣādayaḥ| tatra hetumāha - upasargeti | yata ityādiḥ|| 1.22 ||
analyzed: dvividhāt anvaya vyatirekiṇaḥ pūrva uktam īdṛśam eva pra ādiḥ upasargaḥ eva iti āha kvacid iti bhedāḥ viśeṣāḥ prakarṣa ādayaḥ tatra hetum āha upasarga iti yatas ityādiḥ

original: nanvevamapi pratyayo jñānamityādau bhāvapratyaye uktarīterasambhavāttayoḥ saprāsāpattireveti ata āha - yatratviti| turuktavailakṣaṇye| samānapadopāttasādhanasthale tathā, atra tu bhāvārthakatvenāntaraṅgatvāt vañādau proktarītyaivāgatyā bāhyasādhanasambandhena kriyātvāvagatau upasargasambandha ityarthaḥ| tadāha - antaraṅgtavāditi|
analyzed: nanu evam api pratyayaḥ jñānam ityādau bhāva pratyaye ukta rīteḥ asambhavāt tayoḥ saprāsa āpattiḥ eva iti atas āha yatra tu iti tuḥ ukta vailakṣaṇye samāna pada upātta sādhana sthale tathā atra tu bhāva arthaka tvena antaraṅga tvāt vañ ādau prokta rītyā eva āgatyā bāhya sādhana sambandhena kriyā tva avagatau upasarga sambandhaḥ iti arthaḥ tat āha antaraṅga tavāt iti

original: - nirākāṅkṣatve sati| evañca " vārṇādāṅgam " itinyāyena guṇe yaṇārūpasiddhistadāha - ataeveti| tatra tathā'ṅgīkārādevetyarthaḥ| - ādinā pratyaya ityādi| " samprasāraṇācca " iti sūtrabhāṣyaṃ tu samānapadopāttasādhanaviṣayamiti na taddhirodhaḥ|
analyzed: nirākāṅkṣa tve sati evam ca iti nyāyena guṇe iti nyāyena guṇe ya ṇa ā rūpa siddhiḥ tat āha ataeva iti tatra tathā aṅgīkārāt eva iti arthaḥ ādinā pratyayaḥ ityādi samprasāraṇāt ca iti sūtra bhāṣyam tu samāna pada upātta sādhana viṣayam iti na tad adhirodhaḥ

original: etenātra pūrvamupasargasambandhe'pi " adhyayena" ityādinirdeśaiḥ pūrvaṃ tataḥ sādhanakāryapravṛttiriṣyate iti haradattadyuktam, upasargāṇāṃ vācakatvamevāstu svasvayuktetyādyuktameva karmatvaṃ sakarmakatvaṃ cetyanubhūyata ityadau karmaṇi lādisiddhiriti navyoktaṃ cāpāstam| tatraiva dhātūpasargayoḥ samāsāpatteḥ|
analyzed: etena atra pūrvam upasarga sambandhe api adhyayena ityādi nirdeśaiḥ pūrvam tatas sādhana kārya pravṛttiḥ iṣyate iti haradatta t yuktam upasargāṇām vācaka tvam evā astu sva sva yukta ityādi uktam eva karmatvam sakarmaka tvam ca iti anubhūyate iti ādau karmaṇi la ādi siddhiḥ iti navya uktam ca apāstam tatra eva dhātu upasargayoḥ samāsa āpatteḥ

original: nanvadhyāgacchadītyādāvadhyāderanarthakatvahāraḥ so'trāsaṅgataḥ| kriyānirūpitasambandhaviśeṣadyotakatvaṃ vinā karmapravacanīyatvasya durvacatvāt| kiñca tattve kriyāviśeṣaṇī bhūtārthadyotakatvameva kriyāyogaḥ saca neti tasya gatyādyapavādatvasya durvacatvādata āha - adhyāgacchatīti| āṅastad‌gataviśeṣadyotakatvamanastītyāha - āgacchatīti|
analyzed: nanu adhyāgacchadi ityādau adhi ādeḥ anarthaka tva hāraḥ sotra asaṅgataḥ kriyā nirūpita sambandha viśeṣa dyotaka tvam vinā karmapravacanīya tvasya durvaca tvāt kiñca tattve kriyā viśeṣaṇī bhūta artha dyotaka tvam eva kriyā yogaḥ saca na iti tasya gati ādi apavāda tvasya durvaca tvāt atas āha adhyāgacchati iti āṅaḥ tad gata viśeṣa dyotaka tvam anasti iti āha āgacchati iti

original: etena vaiparītyaṃ nirastam| tatprayogāsaṅgatiṃ pariharati - laukike iti| anyathā kalaśādiprayogo na syāt| gatitvādiprāptape āha - sambhūyeti| sthitayoriti śeṣaḥ| tatprayoge iti bhāvaḥ|- upasargasyeti| tattvādyabhimatsayādhiparyanyatarasya, tattvavata āṅascetyarthaḥ| - arthāntareti| āṅdyotyārthato'nyārthetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: etena vaiparītyam nirastam tad prayoga asaṅgatim pariharati laukike iti anyathā kalaśa ādi prayogaḥ na syāt āha sambhūya iti sthitayoḥ iti śeṣaḥ tad prayoge iti bhāvaḥ upasargasya iti tattva ādi abhimat sayā ādhi pari anyatarasya tattvavataḥ āṅaḥ ca iti arthaḥ artha antara iti

original: karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā tu vacanasāmarthyāditi tātparyam| evamupasargāṇāṃ dyotakatvaṃ tsamakakṣatadanyanipātānāṃ coktam, tadviśadayati - kvacittviti| ghaṭaścetyādāvityarthaḥ| prāderapi saṃgrahāya - nipātānāmiti| dyotakatvasyāpinā saṃgrahaḥ| taccavyavasthitaṃ bodhyam| idamevodāharaṇāntarapradarśanena poṣavati - ataeveti| teṣāṃ vācakatvādevetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: karmapravacanīya saṃjñā tu vacana sāmarthyāt iti tātparyam evam upasargāṇām dyotaka tvam ca uktam tat viśadayati kvacid tu iti ghaṭaḥ ca ityādau iti arthaḥ pra ādeḥ api saṃgrahāya nipātānām iti dyotaka tvasya apinā saṃgrahaḥ tat ca vyavasthitam bodhyam idam eva udāharaṇa antara pradarśanena poṣavati ataeva iti teṣām vācaka tvāt eva iti arthaḥ

original: asya dṛśyate ityatrānvayaḥ| tenānubhavo'tra pramāṇamiti sūcitam| - śabdeiti viṣayasaptamī |nipātānāmityuktiṃ saphavalayannāha - kiñceti| - nasyāditi| tathāsati tasya prakṛtyarthatayā tasyādikaśabdatvena tadyogābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu dyotyārthenaiva tattvamastu prāgvadata āha - tasyeti| arvāgityasyetyarthaḥ|| 1.23 ||
analyzed: asya dṛśyate iti atra anvayaḥ tena anubhavaḥ utra pramāṇam iti sūcitam śabde iti viṣaya saptamī nipātānām iti uktim saphavalayan āha kiñca iti nasyāt iti tathā asati tasya prakṛti artha tayā tasya ādika śabda tvena tad yoga abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu dyotya arthena eva tattvam astu prāgvat atas āha tasya iti arvāk iti asya iti arthaḥ

original: nanu dyotyatve'pi kuto na viśeṣyatvamata āha - ataeveti| tasya viśeṣaṇatvādevetyarthaḥ| - striyāmiti| cāturthike ityarthaḥ| prādhānyātpratyayaviśeṣaṇtave āha - strītyavasyeti| prakṛtipratyayayoriti nyāyāt| - vacaneti| tasya asattvabhūtatvena saṃkhyānanvayāt| anyathā samādhānāsaṅgatisspaṣṭaiva| bhāṣyāntaramapyāha - ataevaceti|
analyzed: nanu dyotya tve api kutas na viśeṣya tvam atas āha ataeva iti tasya viśeṣaṇa tvāt eva iti arthaḥ striyām iti cāturthike iti arthaḥ prādhānyāt pratyaya viśeṣaṇa tave āha strī iti avasyā iti prakṛti pratyayayoḥ iti nyāyāt vacana iti tasya asattva bhūta tvena saṃkhyā ananvayāt anyathā samādhāna asaṅgatiḥ spaṣṭā eva bhāṣya antaram api āha ataeva ca iti

original: nanvādye dyotakatāpakṣo na kaṇṭhata ukto'ta āha - striyāmitīti| idamapi harisaṃmatamityāha - taduktimiti| spaṣaaṭatvādādyamupekṣya dvitīyamāha - keciditi| adhyāgacchatītyādyāśayenāha - kecidanarthakāiti| dṛṣṭāntalabdhamidam| - saṃmbhūyetyatra sthitā iti śeṣaḥ| vācakapadaṃ bodhaparam|
analyzed: nanu ādye dyotakatā pakṣaḥ na kaṇṭhataḥ uktā uta āha striyām iti iti idam api hari saṃmatam iti āha tad uktim iti spaṣa aṭatvāt ādyam upekṣya dvitīyam āha kecid iti adhyāgacchati ityādi āśayena āha kecid anarthakāḥ iti dṛṣṭānta labdham idam saṃmbhūya iti atra sthitāḥ iti śeṣaḥ vācaka padam bodha param

original: kvacittathāpāṭha eva|tathāca ke'pi te yataḥ sambhūya sthitā arthasya bodhakā ato āgamā iva syuranarthakā evetyartho bodhyaḥ| - prātiśākhyeti| dvitīyādhyāsamāptau| jātaṃ samūhaḥ| tānyevādāvuktāni| atra sarvatra prayoktuḥ karttṛtvam| - sattvam-- dravyam| anenāvyayeṣu nāmatvābhāvaḥ spaṣṭamevoktaḥ| uktameva viśadayati - kriyāvācakamityādi|
analyzed: kvacid tathā pāṭhaḥ eva tathā ca ke pi te yatas sambhūya sthitāḥ arthasya bodhakāḥ atas āgamāḥ iva syuḥ anarthakāḥ eva iti arthaḥ bodhyaḥ prātiśākhyā iti dvitīya adhyā samāptau jātam samūhaḥ tāni eva ādau uktāni atra sarvatra prayoktuḥ karttṛ tvam sattvam dravyam anena avyayeṣu nāma tva abhāvaḥ spaṣṭam eva uktaḥ uktam eva viśadayati kriyā vācakam ityādi

original: kriyetyanena bhāvapadārtha uktaḥ|ākhyātapadavācyatvaṃ na pratyayasya kintu viśiṣṭasyeti ca spaṣṭamuktam| - prathameti| dhātusahitena vaktā kriyāmabhidadhātītyarthaḥ| itarābhyāmityasya prakrāntaparatvamityāha - nāmeti| itareityasyārthamāha - nāmeti| brāhmaṇavasiṣṭhanyāyalabdhamidam| - tathā-- tābhyāṃ sahārthavācakāḥ|
analyzed: kriyā iti anena bhāva padārthaḥ uktaḥ ākhyāta pada vācyatvam na pratyayasya kintu viśiṣṭasya iti ca spaṣṭam uktam prathamā iti dhātu sahitena vaktā kriyām abhidadhāti iti arthaḥ itarābhyām ityasya prakrānta paratvam iti āha nāma iti itare ityasya artham āha nāma iti brāhmaṇa vasiṣṭha nyāya labdham idam tathā tābhyām saha artha vācakāḥ

original: pūrvato viśeṣamāha - upasargaiti | - pūraṇā apītyapinādyotakatvādisaṃgrahaḥ| dyotyārthasya prakāratvaṃ vyabhicaritamiti khaṇḍanāyāha - thāliti| tattvameva saviśeṣaṃ viśadayati - natviti| prakāraviśiṣṭavṛttitvetyarthaḥ| - pratyayaṃ-- jātāvekavacanam| ādyadvavyavatirekamāha - yohaririita| antyavyatirekamāha - ākareiti| - etena-- tadadyotakatvena|
analyzed: pūrvatas viśeṣam āha upasargaḥ eti pūraṇā api iti apinā dyotaka tva ādi saṃgrahaḥ dyotya arthasya prakāra tvam vyabhicaritam iti khaṇḍanāya āha thāl iti tattvam eva sa viśeṣam viśadayati na tu iti prakāra viśiṣṭa vṛttitva iti arthaḥ pratyayam jātau ekavacanam ādya dva vyavatirekam āha antya vyatirekam āha ākare iti etena tad adyotaka tvena

original: - tatra-- thālādiviṣaye| anyatrāpi tadvyabhicārabhramamanyathā nirācaṣṭe - jātyantāditi|- turuktavailakṣaṇye| - āśrayeti| jātervyaktireva bandhuḥ|- yaditīti| tena vihitayadāderapi tādarthyādivācakatvamityarthaḥ| teṣāṃ tattvasya prāyeṇetyādipūraṇena prāyikatve mānamāha - tatprakṛteti|
analyzed: tatra thāla ādi viṣaye anyatra api tad vyabhicāra bhramam anyathā nirācaṣṭe jāti antāt iti tuḥ ukta vailakṣaṇye āśraya iti jāteḥ vyaktiḥ eva bandhuḥ yat iti iti tena vihita yad ādeḥ api tādarthya ādi vācakatvam iti arthaḥ teṣām tattvasya prāyeṇa ityādi pūraṇena prāyika tve mānam āha tad prakṛta iti

original: tatrahi-- `pracurārthabodhakātprathamāsamarthātsvārthe mayaḍ " iti pakṣamuktvā, ` prācuryeṇa prastutānnādivacanātprathamāsamarthādadhikaraṇe'rthe mayaḍ ' iti pakṣāntaramuktam| tena bhavanmayo dhyāyati nāvanīpatiriti| siddham| tantreṇārthadvaye sūtratātparyaṃ vyākhyānāditi tadākūtam| apyuktiṃ saphalayati - śarairiti| ata eva tuḥ|
analyzed: tatra hi pracura artha bodhakāt prathamā samarthāt svārthe mayaṭ iti pakṣam uktvā prācuryeṇa prastuta anna ādi vacanāt prathamā samarthāt adhikaraṇa irthe mayaṭ iti pakṣa antaram uktam tena bhavat mayaḥ dhyāyati nāvanīpatiḥ iti siddham tantreṇa artha dvaye sūtra tātparyam vyākhyānāt iti tad ākūtam api uktim saphalayati śaraiḥ iti atas eva tuḥ

original: - anyathā -- vācakatve| tatra pratiyogiviśiṣṭaḥ sadṛśa ivārthaḥ| tatra pratiyoginyusrasyābhedenānvayaḥ, sadṛśasya caśareṣvabhedena| tṛtīya tūpamānopameyayoḥ samānavibhaktikatvaniyamāt| euvañcosrābhinnapratiyogiviśiṣṭasadṛśābhinnaiḥ śarairityādyarthastatpakṣeṇāha - usrasadṛśasyeti|
analyzed: anyathā vācaka tve tatra pratiyogi viśiṣṭaḥ sadṛśaḥ iva arthaḥ tatra pratiyogini usrasya abhedena anvayaḥ sadṛśasya ca śareṣu abhedena tṛtīya tu upamāna upameyayoḥ samāna vibhaktika tva niyamāt tu upamāna upameyayoḥ samāna vibhaktika tva niyamāt śaraiḥ iti ādi arthaḥ tad pakṣeṇa āha usra sadṛśasya iti

original: sādṛśyamivārthaḥ, tatra pratiyogitayosrānvayaḥ, tasyāśrayatayā śareṣvanvayastṛtīyā prāgvatu, tatpakṣe tasya tadabhāvasamuccāyako'piḥ| nairarthakyasyānyatreṣṭatvādāha - asādhutvaceti| ādyapakṣe āha - iveti| - tṛtīyeti| abhāveneticchedaḥ| nanu " avyayād " iti jñāpakāttatsattvamiti tatastadbodho'ta āha - ivaśabdottaramiti|

original: nanvārthaṃ pratīyamānamaniyatadharmakṛtaṃ pratīyeta upasthitatvena bodhyadharmakṛtasyaiva pratyayāt|` gajo vanaṃ gacchatīva śūraḥ samarabhūmiṃ gacchati' ityādau kriyāsamabhivyāhatevādeḥ saṃbhāvanā'rthatvena na tatropamā| ` gaṭakartṛkavanakarmakagamanakriyāsambhāvanāviṣayaḥ śūrakartṛkaṃ samarakarmakaṃ gamanam ' iti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: nanu ārtham pratīyamānam aniyata dharma kṛtam pratīyeta upasthita tvena bodhya dharma kṛtasya eva pratyayāt gajaḥ vanam gacchati iva śūraḥ samara bhūmim gacchati ityādau kriyā samabhivyāhatā iva ādeḥ saṃbhāvanā artha tvena na tatra upamā gaṭa kartṛka vana karmaka gamana kriyā sambhāvanā viṣayaḥ śūra kartṛkam samara karmakam gamanam iti bodhaḥ

original: naca ` ghaṭo na paśyati ' ityato ` ghaṭabhedaṃ paśyati ' iti bodhavāraṇāya dhātvarthaniṣṭaviśeṣyatāvanirūpitaprakāratayā bodhaṃ prati śrūyamāṇavibhaktyantajanyopasthiterhetutvādetad‌bodhānupapattiriti vācyam| dadhi, tūṣṇīm, ārāt, pṛthag ityādīnāṃ dhātvarthānvayānāpatteḥ|
analyzed: naca ghaṭaḥ na paśyati iti atas ghaṭa bhedam paśyati iti bodha vāraṇāya dhātvartha niṣṭa viśeṣya tāva nirūpita prakāratayā bodham prati śrūyamāṇa vibhakti anta janya upasthiteḥ hetutvāt etad bodha anupapattiḥ iti vācyam dadhi tūṣṇīm ārāt pṛthak ityādīnām dhātvartha anvaya anāpatteḥ

original: ghaṭo na paśyatītyādestūktārthe na sādhutvam, bhedārthakanaño'dhikaraṇasākāṅkṣatayā ghaṭo na paṭa ityeva tatra prayogāt| adhikaraṇaprayogaṃ vinā bhinnārthakatvasyābhāvād| āropitaghaṭatvasyāpi na tathā'nvayaḥ| dhātvartha-- sattvavācināmārthobhayavaṣayakabhedasaṃsargakabodhe vibhaktiśaktigrahata ud‌buddhasaskārasya hetutvāt|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ na paśyati ityādeḥ tu ukta arthe na sādhu tvam bheda arthaka nañaḥ udhikaraṇa sākāṅkṣatayā ghaṭaḥ na paṭaḥ iti eva tatra prayogāt adhikaraṇa prayogam vinā bhinna arthaka tvasya abhāvāt āropita ghaṭa tvasya api na tathā anvayaḥ dhātvartha sattva vāci nāma artha ubhaya vaṣayaka bheda saṃsargaka bodhe vibhakti śakti grahataḥ udbuddha saskārasya hetu tvāt

original: viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvānyasaṃsargasya vācakapratyayaṃ vinā'bodhācceti sphuṭamagre ṣaṣṭhīprakaraṇe|
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva anya saṃsargasya vācaka pratyayam vinā bodhāt ca iti sphuṭam agre ṣaṣṭhī prakaraṇe

original: etena ` hesīva ' ityādau sādṛśyasya sarvargaṅgāvagāhanāśraye'nvayaḥ, na tvavagāhane dhātvarthe| dhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣtānirūpitaprakārata| saṃsargeṇa śābdabodhe viśeṣyatayā vibhaktyarthopasthiterhetutvāt| naca nipātārthabhinnavṛttitvena prakāratā viśeṣamīyeti vācyam|
analyzed: etena ityādau sādṛśyasya sarvargaṅga avagāhana āśraya invayaḥ na tu avagāhane dhātvarthe dhātvartha niṣṭha viśeṣtā nirūpita prakārata saṃsargeṇa śābda bodhe viśeṣyatayā vibhakti artha upasthiteḥ hetutvāt na ca nipāta artha bhinna vṛtti tvena prakāratā vācyam

original: ` ghaṭo na paśyati ' ityādau ghaṭādyanvitābhāvasya karmatāsaṃsargeṇa darśane'nvayāpatteḥ| yadi tu dhātvarthe'pi tātparyavaśātsādṛśyānvayo'nubhavasiddhastadā dhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāsambandhenānvayabuddhiṃ prati nañ‌janyopasthiteḥ pratibandhakatvamātraṃ parikalpya ` ghaṭo na paśyati ' ityādau tathā bodho vivārya iti
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ na paśyati ityādau ghaṭa ādi anvita abhāvasya karmatā saṃsargeṇa darśana invaya āpatteḥ yadi tu dhātvarthe pi tātparya vaśāt sādṛśya anvayaḥ anubhava siddhaḥ tadā dhātvartha niṣṭha viśeṣyatā nirūpita prakāratā sambandhena anvaya buddhim prati nañ janya upasthiteḥ pratibandhaka tva mātram parikalpya ghaṭaḥ na paśyati ityādau tathā bodhaḥ vivāryaḥ iti

original: taduktamāpāstam| kriyānyasamabhivyāhṛtsayātyantābhāvārthakatvasyābhāvāccetyagre sphuṭībhaviṣyati|
analyzed: tat uktam āpāstam kriyā anya samabhivyāhṛt sayā atyanta abhāva arthaka tvasya abhāvāt ca iti agre sphuṭībhaviṣyati

original: samāsasthale uktaprakāraṃ vinā sarvathā na gatiriti tatra tadāvaśyakatve tadaikarūpyāya prāguktavyastasthale'pi tathaivocitamiti tatra tathoktaṃ samarthayate - idameva yuktamityādinā| tatra hetumāha - ghaneti| yata ityādiḥ| - vigrahe iti| alaukikavigrahe ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: samāsa sthale ukta prakāram vinā sarvathā na gatiḥ iti tatra tad āvaśyaka tve tad aikarūpyāya prāgukta vyasta sthale api tathā eva ucitam iti tatra tathā uktam samarthayate idam eva yuktam ityādinā tatra hetum āha ghana iti yatas ityādiḥ vigrahe iti alaukika vigrahe iti arthaḥ

original: anyathā tasyānyārthakatvena vigrahatvāpattyā tatra tadarthāntarbhāveṇa samāso na syāt| ivasya tatrāpyabhāvāt, asāmānādhikaraṇyācceti bhāvaḥ| siddhāntamāha - upamānatveneti| anyathā sasambandhikatvāt " sāmānyavacanaiḥ " ityeva tena samāsalābhe taddhaiyarthyaṃ spaṣṭameva| svararasādāraṇamāha - sāmānyeti| adikṛtamāha - samānādhikaraṇairiti|
analyzed: anyathā tasya anya arthaka tvena vigraha tva āpattyā tatra tad artha antarbhāveṇa samāsaḥ na syāt ivasya tatra api abhāvāt asāmānādhikaraṇyāt ca iti bhāvaḥ siddhāntam āha upamāna tvena iti anyathā sa sambandhika tvāt sāmānya vacanaiḥ iti eva tena samāsa lābhe tad haiyarthyam spaṣṭam eva svara rasa ādāraṇam āha sāmānya iti adi kṛtam āha samāna adhikaraṇaiḥ iti

original: upamānaparatvasyaivābhāvena tattvena bodhakatvaṃ sutarāṃ nāstītyāśayenāha - ghanapadeti| - apinā śyāmapadasaṃhag‌rahaḥ| " sāmpratikābhāve" iti nyāyenāha - na ceti| - ukteti| tatrāpi tasva tatparatvāvaśyakatvamityuktetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: upamāna para tvasya eva abhāvena tattvena bodhaka tvam sutarām nā asti iti āśayena āha ghana pada iti apinā śyāma pada saṃha grahaḥ sāmpratika abhāve iti nyāyena āha na ca iti uktā iti tatra api tasva tad para tva āvaśyaka tvam iti uktā iti arthaḥ

original: laukikavigrahetu ivasya sattve'pi samānādhikaraṇyāya tasya tatparatvamāvaśyakamiti tatrāpi tattvābhāvaḥ, tad dhvanayannāha - ghaneneti| śyāma iti śeṣaḥ| - tathātve'pīti| ghanatvenopamānabodhakatve'pi vyadhikaraṇatvena tasya tadavigrahatvādityarthaḥ| nanu tasya tadavigrahatve'pi agatyā tatratyameva tad gṛhyate'ta āha - pratyāsattyeti|
analyzed: laukika vigrahaḥ tu ivasya sattve api samānādhikaraṇyāya tasya tad paratvam āvaśyakam iti tatra api tattva abhāvaḥ tat dhvanayan āha ghanena iti śyāmaḥ iti śeṣaḥ tathātve pi iti ghana tvena upamāna bodhaka tve pi vyadhikaraṇa tvena tasya tad avigraha tvāt iti arthaḥ nanu tasya tad avigraha tve pi agatyā tatratyam eva tat gṛhyate itaḥ āha pratyāsattyā iti

original: - tatra-- tasyām| anyathā nīloptalādāvatiprasaṅgāpatteḥ| ata evāha - tasyeti| yatra samāsastatra sāmānādhikaraṇayāpekṣā natu laukikavigrahavākye iti tatra vaiyadhikaraṇye'pi yāvattadarthabodhakatvamātreṇāgatyā tattvāṅgīkāre ityarthaḥ| evaṃca na samāsāpattirdoṣaḥ| ata evāha - puṃvattveti| nanu tadapi samāsavatsusādhamata āha - vṛttāviti|
analyzed: tatra tasyām anyathā nīloptala ādau atiprasaṅga āpatteḥ atas eva āha tasya iti yatra samāsaḥ tatra sāmānādhikaraṇayā apekṣā na tu laukika vigraha vākye iti tatra vaiyadhikaraṇye api yāvat tad artha bodhaka tva mātreṇa āgatyā tattva aṅgīkāre iti arthaḥ evam ca na samāsa āpattiḥ doṣaḥ atas eva āha puṃvat tva iti nanu tat api samāsa vat susādham atas āha vṛttau iti

original: ata eva darśanīyāyā mātā darśanīyāmātetyādau dvayorekaviśeṣyakapratītijanakatvena tatra sāmānādhikaraṇye'pi na puṃvattvam| ata evātra pakṣe puṃvattvāsiddhirbhāṣye uktā| tad dhvanayanna ha - eneti| puṃvattvāsādhanenetyarthaḥ| kaiyaṭāśayāntaramāha - kevaleti| iyameva pūravāvasthā natu vigrahavākyaghaṭakatvāvasthā | - sarvatheti|
analyzed: atas eva darśanīyāyāḥ mātā darśanīyā mātā ityādau dvayoḥ eka viśeṣyaka pratīti janakatvena tatra sāmānādhikaraṇye api na puṃvat tvam atas eva atra pakṣe puṃvat tva asiddhiḥ bhāṣye uktā tat dhvanayan na ha enā iti puṃvat tva asādhanena iti arthaḥ kaiyaṭa āśaya antaram āha kevalā iti iyam eva pūrava avasthā na tu vigraha vākya ghaṭaka tva avasthā sarvathā iti

original: śastrītvena tasya bodhakatve'pi niyāmakāsamabhivyāhāreṇa tasya tattvenābodhakatvāt anyathā'tiprasaṅgāpatteḥ|
analyzed: śa strī tvena tasya bodhaka tve api niyāmaka asamabhivyāhāreṇa tasya tattvena abodhaka tvāt anyathā atiprasaṅga āpatteḥ

original: etena pūrvapadaṃ tatsadṛśe lākṣamaikamiti dyotayituṃ laukikavigrahe ivaśabdaḥ prayujyate iti lākṣaṇikamiti| ata eva sāmānādhikaraṇyānmṛgacapaletyādau puṃvattvam| kathaṃ tarhyupamānaparatvamiti cet| bhūtapūrvagatyā śakyārthamādāyetyavehīti|
analyzed: etena pūrva padam tad sadṛśe lākṣama ekam iti dyotayitum laukika vigrahe iva śabdaḥ prayujyate iti lākṣaṇikam iti atas eva sāmānādhikaraṇyāt mṛga capala ityādau puṃvat tvam katham tarhi upamāna paratvam iti ced bhūtapūrva gatyā śakya artham ādāya iti avehi iti

original: anatiprasaṅgāyāvaśya kasyobhayatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasya nirvāhāya tatra vākye'pi tat sadṛśalākṣaṇikam ivastvasyaivārthasya dyotakaḥ| ` ghanasamānasadaśaḥ śyāma ' iti bodhaḥ sarvatreti ca dīkṣītādyuktam, aravindasundaramiti samāse tvaravindapadenāravindanirūpitasādṛśyaprayojakābhinnasaundaryavadabhinnaṃ vadanamiti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: anatiprasaṅgāya avaśya kasya ubhayatra sāmānādhikaraṇyasya nirvāhāya tatra vākye pi tat sadṛśa lākṣaṇikam iva stvasya eva arthasya dyotakaḥ ghana samāna sa daśaḥ śyāmaḥ iti bodhaḥ sarvatra iti ca dīkṣīta ādi uktam aravinda sundaram iti samāse tu aravinda padena aravinda nirūpita sādṛśya prayojaka abhinna saundarya vat abhinnam vadanam iti bodhaḥ

original: ekadeśānvayāyogādaravindameva lakṣaṇāyā sarvārthabodhakaṃ sundarapadaṃ tu tātparyagrāhakamityeke iti taduktaṃ cāpāstam| uktarītibhiḥ samāsādyanāpattestathābodhāsambhavācca| uktadoṣadvayamasāmānādhikaraṇyādanyapakṣe'tidiśati - evamiti | tatra pakṣe ivetyarthaḥ| sādṛśyasya saṃsargatayā bhānaṃ natu tadvat prakāratayeti bhāvaḥ| - tat-- ubhayam|
analyzed: eka deśa anvaya ayogāt aravindam eva lakṣaṇāyā sarva artha bodhakam sundara padam tu tātparya grāhakam iti eke iti tat uktam ca apāstam ukta rītibhiḥ samāsa ādi anāpatteḥ tathā bodha asambhavāt ca ukta doṣa dvayam asāmānādhikaraṇyāt anya pakṣa iti diśati evam iti tatra pakṣe iva iti arthaḥ sādṛśyasya saṃsarga tayā bhānam na tu tadvat prakāra tayā iti bhāvaḥ tat ubhayam

original: uktarītyā prācāṃ matena samāsamabhyupetya puṃvattvābhāvadoṣa uktaḥ| vastutaḥ siddhāntarītyā so'pi netyāha - kiñceti| tathābodhe iti śeṣaḥ| śyāmatvavaiśiṣṭyenopameyasyaiva pratīterāha - śyameti| - tasya-- ghanasya|tathāca tenāboghakatvātsamāso neti bhāvaḥ|| 1.26 ||
analyzed: ukta rītyā prācām matena samāsam abhyupetya puṃvat tva abhāva doṣaḥ uktaḥ vastutas siddhānta rītyā saḥ api na iti āha kiñca iti tathā bodhe iti śeṣaḥ śyāma tva vaiśiṣṭyena upameyasya eva pratīteḥ āha śyama iti tasya ghanasya tathā ca tena āboghaka tvāt samāsaḥ na iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathārthabodhalābho na paroktabodhalābha ityāśayenoktārthe tatsasamaṃtimapyāha - taduktamiti| - kaiyaṭo'pi --uktamityasyānuṣaṅgaḥ| tadevāha - na ceti| - uktamiti| śastryāḥ sādhāramadharmavattvenetaparicchadekatvarūpamityarthaḥ| tattvāyaiva hi tadapekṣeti bhāvaḥ| bhāṣyādyanuktamāha - śyāmetyeti| guṇavyakterviśeṣyatayā strītvam|
analyzed: tathā artha bodha lābhaḥ na para ukta bodha lābhaḥ iti āśayena ukta arthe tad sasamaṃtim api āha tat uktam iti kaiyaṭaḥ api uktam iti asya anuṣaṅgaḥ tat eva āha na ca iti uktam iti śastryāḥ sādhāram adharmavattvena ita paricchada ekatva rūpam iti arthaḥ tattvāya eva hi tad apekṣā iti bhāvaḥ bhāṣya ādi anuktam āha śyāmā itya iti guṇa vyakteḥ viśeṣya tayā strītvam

original: nanu samāmānyavactvantādṛśamityatraiva kiṃ mānamata āha - ata eveti| tasya tadrūpatvādevetyarthaḥ| - pakṣeiti| sādṛśyasambandhenānvaya iti bhāvaḥ| upamānābhramāyāha - tatreti| siddhānte ityarthaḥ| anena tasya tadrūpatvaṃ spaṣṭamevoktam| bādhanirāsāyāha - upeti|
analyzed: nanu samāmānyavactvam tādṛśam iti atra eva kim mānam atas āha atas eva iti tasya tad rūpa tvāt eva iti arthaḥ pakṣe iti sādṛśya sambandhena anvayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ upamāna abhramāya āha tatra iti siddhānte iti arthaḥ anena tasya tad rūpa tvam spaṣṭam eva uktam bādha nirāsāya āha upa iti

original: nanvevamapi sādṛśyasyānyamūlakatvasya vācyatvādetanmūlakatvasyoktarītyā'sambhavāt, bhāṣyate'lābhāccatādṛśopānatvālābhenoktabhāṣyāsaṅgatirata āha - tatreti| upameye ityarthaḥ| - asyaiva-- śyāmatvasyaiva| - tantrādītyādinā bod‌dhurāvṛttiḥ| tathācātra tantramasahavivakṣāviṣayavibhaktyantatantraṃ bodhyam|
analyzed: nanu evam api sādṛśyasya anya mūlaka tvasya vācyatvāt etad mūlaka tvasya ukta rītyā asambhavāt bhāṣya te lābhāt ca tādṛśa upānatva alābhena ukta bhāṣya asaṅgatiḥ atas āha tatra iti upameye iti arthaḥ asya eva śyāma tvasya eva tantra ādi ityādinā boddhuḥ āvṛttiḥ tathāca atra tantram asaha vivakṣā viṣaya vibhakti anta tantram bodhyam

original: upāttadharmasattve sāṃnidhyāttenaiva sā pratītiranubhavasiddheti bhāvaḥ| atra saṃmatimāha - taduktamiti| tātparyagrāhakamāha - vṛddheti| atra bhāṣyasaṃmatimapyāha - ataeveti| - tasyaiva-- tatrānvayādevetyarthaḥ| asyobhayatrānvayaḥ|
analyzed: upātta dharma sattve sāṃnidhyāt tena eva sā pratītiḥ anubhava siddhā iti bhāvaḥ atra saṃmatim āha tat uktam iti tātparya grāhakam āha vṛddha iti atra bhāṣya saṃmatim api āha ataeva iti tasya eva tatra anvayāt eva iti arthaḥ asya ubhayatra anvayaḥ

original: etaduttaramitisūcitaṃ nāvadhāraṇaparaṃ bhāṣyamityata āha - śastrīśabdenāpīti |nanvevaṃ śaṅkā'saṅgatirataḥ siddhāntānurodhenāha - bahūnāmiti| bahugatadharmasyaiva sāmānyatvamiti tatra samāse dvigatadharmabodhakatvenātattvāditi bhāvaḥ| ubhayatretyasya vyakhyā - śastryāmiti| - bahūnāmiti| bahūnānteṣāmeva |
analyzed: etat uttaram iti sūcitam na avadhāraṇa param bhāṣyam iti atas āha śa strī śabdena api iti nanu evam śaṅkā saṅgatiḥ atas siddhānta anurodhena āha bahūnām iti bahu gata dharmasya eva sāmānyatvam iti tatra samāse dvi gata dharma bodhaka tvena atattvāt iti bhāvaḥ ubhayatra ityasya vyakhyā śastryām iti bahūnām iti eva

original: nanvetadbhāṣyata ubhayatra guṇasattāyāḥ, śabde dvācakatvasya ca lābha'pyubhayatrānvayo na labdo'ta āha - atreti| siddhāntabhāṣye ityarthaḥ| anyathā tadvattvāccetyeva siddhe tathoktiradhiketi spaṣṭameva|

original: prathavā punarastūttarapadārthapradhāna ityaneneti| bhāvaḥ| nanvevaṃ katham ` adrutāyāmasaṃhiti tviṃti| āropitaḥ paraḥ saṃnikarṣa iti tadarthaḥ| - sūtriti| etadubhayaprāmāṇyātstrīnapuṃsakīlaṅga ityarthaḥ| saṃhitaśabda iti pāṭhaḥ| atrānyasaṃmatimapyāha - ata eveti| klīvāṅgīkārādevetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: prathavā punar astu uttara padārtha pradhānaḥ iti anena iti bhāvaḥ nanu evam katham āropitaḥ paraḥ saṃnikarṣaḥ iti tad arthaḥ sūtr iti etad ubhaya prāmāṇyāt strī napuṃsakī laṅgaḥ iti arthaḥ saṃhita śabdaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ atra anya saṃmatim api āha atas eva iti klīva aṅgīkārāt eva iti arthaḥ

original: etena sūtravārttikaprayogādavyayībhāvena saha nañ‌tatpuruṣo vaikalpika iti dīkṣitādyuktamapāstam| asandeha ityasya gatiruktaiva | tadāha - anyatreti| śekharādāvityarthaḥ| taduktadoṣamuddharati - sattveneti| tasyaiva tatpratibandhakatvāt| nanu tatraiva na mānamata āha - kaṇādeti| tallābhe bījamāha - saṃsargasyāpīti| apinā sattādisamuccayaḥ|
analyzed: etena sūtra vārttika prayogāt avyayībhāvena saha nañ tatpuruṣaḥ vaikalpikaḥ iti dīkṣita ādi uktam apāstam asandehaḥ iti asya gatiḥ uktā eva tat āha anyatra iti śekhara ādau iti arthaḥ tad ukta doṣam uddharati sattvena iti tasya eva tad pratibandhaka tvāt nanu tatra eva na mānam atas āha kaṇāda iti tad lābhe bījam āha saṃsargasya api iti apinā sattā ādi samuccayaḥ

original: evaṃ ca tat prāguktarītyā'yuktameveti tadrītyā pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭāntadānaṃ na svarītyeti na siddhānte tadvirodha iti ca bodhyam|
analyzed: evam ca tat prāgukta rītyā ayuktam eva iti tad rītyā pūrvam dṛṣṭānta dānam na sva rītyā iti na siddhānte tad virodhaḥ iti ca bodhyam

original: kiñca uktabhāṣyādapi atyantābhāvārthakanañaḥ kriyādiprativogikābhāvabodhakatvenottarādipadārthenānanvayādasamāmarthyenānanvayādasamārthyenāvyayībhāvo na nirmakṣikamityādivaditi tathā vākyopapattāvapi tathā bodhasyaiva lābha iti tathā bodho'yukta eva| na sandeha ityādau tu sandehasya guṇatvādbhavatyeva nañā tadabhāvabodhanamiti sāmarthyamastvena |
analyzed: kiñca ukta bhāṣyāt api atyanta abhāva arthaka nañaḥ kriyā ādi prativogika abhāva bodhaka tvena uttara ādi padārthena ananvayāt asamāmarthyena ananvayāt asamārthyena avyayībhāvaḥ na nirmakṣikam ityādi vat iti tathā vākya upapattau api tathā bodhasya eva lābhaḥ iti tathā bodhaḥ yuktaḥ eva na sandehaḥ ityādau tu sandehasya guṇa tvāt bhavati eva nañā tad abhāva bodhanam iti sāmarthyam astvena

original: so'pyuktīratyaiveti na doṣaḥ| idamanupadameva sphuṃṭībhaviṣyatīti na pūrvavirodhaḥ| etena bhūtale na ghaṭa ityādau ghaṭātyantābhāve bhūtalādyanvitasya saptamyarthādheyatvasyevaṃ tātparyavāśāt ghaṭādau saptamyantabhūtalādivṛttitvābhāvasyānvayabodho'nubhavasiddhaḥ|
analyzed: saḥ upi uktīḥ ratyā eva iti na doṣaḥ idam anupadam eva sphuṃṭībhaviṣyati iti na pūrva virodhaḥ etena bhū tale na ghaṭaḥ ityādau ghaṭa atyanta abhāve bhū tala ādi anvitasya saptamī artha ādheya tvasya ivam tātparya vāśāt ghaṭa ādau saptamī anta bhū tala ādi vṛtti tva abhāvasya anvaya bodhaḥ anubhava siddhaḥ

original: anyathā tādṛśavākyajanyasyāprāmāṇyajñānānāskanditābhāvābodhasya bhūtale ghaṭa ityādivākyajanyaghaṭādiviśeṣyakabhūtalādheyatvaprakārakabodhavirodhitāyā anupapatteḥ|
analyzed: anyathā tādṛśa vākya janyasya aprāmāṇya jñāna anāskandita abhāva abodhasya bhū tale ghaṭaḥ ityādi vākya janya ghaṭa ādi viśeṣyaka bhū tala ādheya tva prakāraka bodha virodhi tāyāḥ anupapatteḥ

original: nañ‌padaṃ vinā yatra dharmiṇi yasya viśeṣaṇatayā bhānaṃ yādṛśasamabhivyāhāradbhavati tādṛsamabhivyāhārasthale nañsattve tatra dharmiṇi tadabhāvaḥ pratīyate iti anubhavāpalāpaprasaṅgāt iti vyatpattivādādyuktamapyapāstam| uktayukteḥ| uktirītyā pratibandhakatvopapatteḥ ,tato'pi kriyāviśeṣyakabodhasyaivoktarītyā sattvaṃcceti dik| tadāha - itidigiti|
analyzed: nañ padam vinā yatra dharmiṇi yasya viśeṣaṇatayā bhānam yādṛśa samabhivyāhārat bhavati tādṛśa samabhivyāhāra sthale nañ sattve tatra dharmiṇi tad abhāvaḥ pratīyate iti anubhava apalāpa prasaṅgāt iti vyatpattivāda ādi uktam api apāstam ukta yukteḥ ukti rītyā pratibandhaka tva upapatteḥ tatas api kriyā viśeṣyaka bodhasya eva ukta rītyā sattvam ca iti diś tat āha iti diś iti

original: yattu tvanmate pṛthivyāmityādau pratīterekaviśeṣyatvānubhavo virudhyetāto maduktameva yuktamiti sā, tat khaṇḍayati- pṛthivyāmiti| tātparyavaśātkadācitprātipadikārthaviśeṣyakavibhaktyarthavṛttitvābhāvāvāṃśceti bodhādāha - pratītereketi|anyathā na jale ityatra gandhapadāvṛttiprasaṅga iti tadbhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yat tu tvad mate pṛthivyām ityādau pratīteḥ eka viśeṣya tva anubhavaḥ virudhyeta atas mad uktam eva yuktam iti sā tat khaṇḍayati pṛthivyām iti tātparya vaśāt kadācid prātipadika artha viśeṣyaka vibhakti artha vṛtti tva abhāvāvān ca iti bodhāt āha pratīteḥ eka iti anyathā na jale iti atra gandha pada avṛtti prasaṅgaḥ iti tad bhāvaḥ

original: yattu pṛthivīvṛttigandhapratiyogikābhāvavajjalamityartha iti| tanna| jale iti saptamyanupapatteḥ| tadabhāvo jalavṛttiriti bodhe pṛthivyāmiti saptāmyanupapatti, tatpadavaiyarthyāpattiśca| tasmātsiddhāntarītyā pratītidvayaṃ bhinnaviśeṣyakam|
analyzed: yat tu pṛthivī vṛtti gandha pratiyogika abhāvavat jalam iti arthaḥ iti tat na jale iti saptamī anupapatteḥ tad abhāvaḥ jala vṛttiḥ iti bodhe pṛthivyām iti tad pada vaiyarthya āpattiḥ ca tasmāt siddhānta rītyā pratīti dvayam bhinna viśeṣyakam

original: etenoktarītyā saptamyarthānvitābhāvasya viśeṣaṇatayā pratiyoginyanvayād bhūtalavṛttyabhāvapratiyogī ghaṭa itivajjalavṛttyabhāvapratiyogī gandhaḥ pṛthivyāmiti vinaivāvṛttiṃ bodha iti matamapi nirastamiti dik| tadāha - iti digiti||1.34||
analyzed: etena ukta rītyā saptamī artha anvita abhāvasya viśeṣaṇatayā pratiyogini anvayāt bhū tala vṛtti abhāva pratiyogī ghaṭaḥ iti vat jala vṛtti abhāva pratiyogī gandhaḥ pṛthivyām iti vinā eva avṛttim bodhaḥ iti matam api nirastam iti diś tat āha iti diś iti

original: siddhānte prāptadoṣamuddharati - nekṣetodyantamiti| astaṃ yāntaṃ kadācana|
analyzed: siddhānte prāpta doṣam uddharati na īkṣeta udyantam iti astam yāntam kadācana

original: noparaktaṃ na vāristhaṃ na madhyaṃ nabhaso gatam|
analyzed: na uparaktam na vāri stham na madhyam nabhasaḥ gatam

original: ityasya parigrahaḥ| idaṃ ca snātakavratāntargataṃ na mānavam, na yājñavalkyīyam, nāpyapastambīm, kintu brahmacāridharmabhūtaprajāpativratāntargatam| tadutsarge " karmāṇi puruṣārthāya ' ityādituryādyapādasthajaiminisūtraviṣayabhūtantadāha - tasyeti| asya vyākhyā - brahmeti| - īkṣaṇābhāveti|
analyzed: iti asya parigrahaḥ idam ca snātaka vrata antargatam na mānavam na yājñavalkyīyam na api apastambīm kintu brahmacāri dharma bhūta prajāpati vrata antargatam tad utsarge karmāṇi puruṣa arthāya ityādi turya ādya pāda stha jaimini sūtra viṣaya bhūtam tat āha tasya iti asya vyākhyā brahma iti īkṣaṇa abhāva iti

original: ata eva snātakavrataprakaraṇe " udyantamastaṃ yantamādityaṃ darśane varjayed " ityāpastambaḥ saṅgacchate|evañcoktananiyamātprasajyapratiṣedha eva tatreti bhāvaḥ| tatsūtrasthamīmāṃsakavijñāneśvarādimataṃ khaṇḍayati - yattviti| -tatra-- puryudāse| - vrateti | tadvācītyādiḥ| ata eva sāmānyaprāptiḥ , tatra niṣedhalabdhamādāyāha - tadbhinneti|
analyzed: atas eva snātaka vrata prakaraṇe udyantam astam yantam ādityam darśane varjayet iti āpastambaḥ saṅgacchate evam ca ukta na niyamāt prasajya pratiṣedhaḥ eva tatra iti bhāvaḥ tad sūtra stha mīmāṃsaka vijñāneśvara ādi matam khaṇḍayati yat tu iti tatra puryudāse vrata iti tat vāci ityādiḥ atas eva sāmānya prāptiḥ tatra niṣedha labdham ādāya āha tad bhinna iti

original: nañivayuktanyāyenāha - kriyāyāiti |- prāptyāceti| tadviśeṣajijñāsāyāṃ puruṣakriyāmātrasya saṅkalpapūrvakatayā pratyāsattyā tatsamabhivyāhāreṇa ceti śeṣaḥ| anyathā manvāśvalāyanāpastambādikṛtatathopakramavirodhaḥ spaṣṭa eveti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nañ iva yukta nyāyena āha kriyāyāḥ iti prāptyā ca iti tad viśeṣa jijñāsāyām puruṣa kriyā mātrasya saṅkalpa pūrvakatayā pratyāsattyā tad samabhivyāhāreṇa ca iti śeṣaḥ anyathā manu āśvalāyana āpastamba ādi kṛta tathā upakrama virodhaḥ spaṣṭaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: udayāstamayakālayoḥ pratyahaṃ saṅkalpa iti tantraratanādyuktamasaṅgatamiti dhvanayannuktāpastambamūlakamevāha - nekṣiṣyāmīti| yathā caitattathā spaṣṭaṃ mitākṣarāvyākhyāyāḥ sūcyām| ataeva vijñāneśvareṇāpi māṃsabhakṣāṇavidhiniṣeyormatyavādyekavākyatayā tathaiva saṅkalpo darśitaḥ| idamapyabhyupetyoktam| vastutastadeva netyāha - kiñceti | - yatreti|
analyzed: udaya astamaya kālayoḥ pratyaham saṅkalpaḥ iti tantraratana ādi uktam asaṅgatam iti dhvanayan ukta āpastamba mūlakam eva āha na īkṣiṣyāmi iti yathā ca etat tathā spaṣṭam mitākṣarā vyākhyāyāḥ sūcyām ataeva vijñāneśvareṇa api tathā eva saṅkalpaḥ darśitaḥ idam api abhyupetya uktam vastutas tat eva na iti āha kiñca iti yatra iti

original: svavākyopātte ityarthaḥ| etena vratena tatsattvāccintyamityapāstam| tasya vākyāntaratvāt| tathā sati tathā'nvayasyaiva sattvena tadākāṅkṣāmātrasyaivābhāvācca| anvayasya bīdhitatvādāha- ākāṅkṣeti| tanmātramityarthaḥ|
analyzed: sva vākya upātte iti arthaḥ etena vratena tad sattvāt cintyam iti apāstam tasya vākya antara tvāt tathā sati tathā anvayasya eva sattvena tad ākāṅkṣā mātrasya eva abhāvāt ca anvayasya bīdhita tvāt āha ākāṅkṣā iti tad mātram iti arthaḥ

original: bhinnārthakāttasya bodhe'pi samānavibhaktināmārthayoritivyutpattyā tadākāṅkṣā sambhavati, tasyā asaddhiṣayāyā api bahuśo dṛṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ| - naca-- nahi| tadaviṣayatayā bādhena ca vayutpattyantareṇa bhedasambandhenaivānvayasya tasya tadākāṅkṣāyāśca sattvāt| ghaṭo na nīla ityādau ca vakṣyamāṇarītyā'tyantābhāvādhīreva, na bhedadhīḥ|
analyzed: bhinna arthakāt tasya bodhe api samāna vibhakti nāma arthayoḥ iti vyutpattyā tad ākāṅkṣā sambhavati tasyāḥ asat hiṣayāyāḥ api bahuśas dṛṣṭa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ na ca nahi tad aviṣayatayā bādhena ca bheda sambandhena eva anvayasya tasya tad ākāṅkṣāyāḥ ca sattvāt ghaṭaḥ na nīlaḥ ityādau ca vakṣyamāṇa rītyā atyanta abhāva adhīḥ eva na bheda dhīḥ

original: tatra tadabhāve tathā'nvayasyaiva sattvena tadākāṅkṣāmātrasyā sattvācca| vakṣyamāṇīratyā viparītadhīrapi na |
analyzed: tatra tad abhāve tathā anvayasya eva sattvena tad ākāṅkṣā mātrasya ā sattvāt ca vakṣyamāṇī ratyā viparīta dhīḥ api na

original: etena naño'bhāve yatrābhedenānvayabādhastatra nañā'tyatābhāvadhīryatra tadabhāve'bhedenānvayastatra tena bhedadhīstatra ca tattadākāṅkṣājñānādyeva niyāmakamiti naiyāyikādyuktapāstam|
analyzed: etena nañaḥ bhāve yatra abhedena anvaya bādhaḥ tatra nañā atyatā abhāva dhīḥ yatra tad abhāve bhedena anvayaḥ tatra tena bheda dhīḥ tatra ca tad tad ākāṅkṣā jñāna ādi eva niyāmakam iti naiyāyika ādi ukta pāstam

original: taddetad dhvanayannāha - ata eveti| uktaniyamādevetyarthaḥ| paramate tu ghaṭaḥ paṭo netyetattulyatayā'trāpi sa syāditi bhāvaḥ| upasaṃhannāha - ata eveti| ukto'rthaḥ| ataeva ` na pacati caitra ityataḥ ' caitrabhinnakartṛkaḥ pāka' ityabodhaḥ| viśeṣaṃ vaktumāha - abameveti| tatsamabhivyāhṛtanañ‌boadhayātyantābhāva evetyarthaḥ| prasajyetyasyārthaḥ|
analyzed: tat tat dhvanayan āha atas eva iti ukta niyamāt eva iti arthaḥ para mate tu ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ na iti etad tulya tayā atra api sa syāt iti bhāvaḥ upasaṃhan āha atas eva iti uktaḥ ṛthaḥ ataeva na pacati caitraḥ iti atas caitra bhinna kartṛkaḥ pākaḥ iti a bodhaḥ viśeṣam vaktum āha abam eva iti tad samabhivyāhṛta nañ boadhayā atyanta abhāvaḥ eva iti arthaḥ prasajya ityasya arthaḥ

original: - vidhāyeti| viśiṣṭaphalitārthamāha - vihiteti| vidhānaṃ na tadasamabhivyāhṛtavākyato bodhyam| tameva viśeṣamāha - nañ‌sūtre iti| - tena-- bhāṣyīyatathākathanena | " na ekaṃ priyam " iti tatroktam| nadvitvāśayakamityarthata āha - nāsmākamiti| yenanāprāpteitivannetyāha - atrahīti | bahupratiyaśabdaḥ pātrādiḥ| bahupriyatetipāṭhastu sugama eva|
analyzed: vidhāya iti viśiṣṭa phalita artham āha vihita iti vidhānam na tad asamabhivyāhṛta vākyataḥ bodhyam tam eva viśeṣam āha nañ sūtre iti tena bhāṣyīya tathā kathanena na ekam priyam iti tatra uktam na dvitva āśayakam iti arthataḥ āha na asmākam iti yena na aprāpte iti vat na iti āha atrahi iti bahu pratiya śabdaḥ pātra ādiḥ bahu priya tā iti pāṭhaḥ tu sugamaḥ eva

original: prāguktadārḍhyāyodāharaṇāntaramāha - nasandeha iti| abhiyuktoktivirodhaṃ pariharati - prasajyeti | evaṃ ca na tathaiva kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, kintu tatra tādṛśadhātuguṇavācakapādanyataparajanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇamiti bodhyaḥ|| 1.35||
analyzed: prāk ukta dārḍhyāya udāharaṇa antaram āha na sandehaḥ iti abhiyukta ukti virodham pariharati prasajya iti evam ca na tathā eva kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ kintu tatra tādṛśa dhātu guṇa vācaka pāda nyata para janya upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti bodhyaḥ

original: evaṃ tadarthātyantābhāvaṃ nirūpya bhedaṃ nirūpayati - yantya iti| bheda ityarthaḥ| so'pi samāsavādārtha eva, na śābda iti pratipādayituṃ mīmāṃsakanaiyāyikamataṃ khaṇḍayati - yattviti| - nañarthaḥ--tadvācyaḥ| - evaṃ tarhītyasya yata ityādiḥ| lakṣaṇayā āha - paṭapadamiti| - bhede-- nañarthe| - abhedānvayaḥ-- abhedenānvayaḥ|
analyzed: evam tad artha atyanta abhāvam nirūpya bhedam nirūpayati yantyaḥ iti bhedaḥ iti arthaḥ saḥ api samāsa vāda arthaḥ eva na śābdaḥ iti pratipādayitum mīmāṃsaka naiyāyika matam khaṇḍayati yat tu iti nañ arthaḥ tad vācyaḥ evam tarhi iti asya yatas ityādiḥ lakṣaṇayā āha paṭa padam iti bhede nañ arthe abheda anvayaḥ abhedena anvayaḥ

original: nanu vyutpattiviruddhamāntyamata āha - abhedeti| nanvevamādyabodho'pi na syādata āha - yadveti| bhedetyasya pratiyogiviśiṣṭetyādiḥ| tathā ca sākāṅkṣātvātpratiyogini paṭasya abhedenānvayo viśiṣṭasya ghaṭe tatheti| tasmādanyathātve'pi na ko'pi doṣo'treti bhāvaḥ| ekadeśyuktaṃ khaṇḍayati paraḥ - bhedavatīti|

analyzed: tad avṛtti tvena gṛhīta pṛthivī vṛtti samabhivyāhṛta ghaṭa tva rūpa padārtha viśeṣyakā iti arthaḥ ghaṭa tva prakārakā iti apapāṭhaḥ pṛthivī vṛtti tbasya ghaṭa tve prasiddha tvāt tad avṛtti tvam tatra iti jñānavantam prati na prayogaḥ kintu tatra anya vṛtti tva jñānavantam prati eva prayogaḥ iti pṛthivī avṛtti na iti na prati nirdeśaḥ iti āha na anya vṛtti iti avadhāraṇa iti

original: pṛthivītvasāmānādhikaraṇyenetyādiḥ| paramate ṛtāvityatra kriyāsaṅgatatve'pyayogavyavacchedabodhakatvena ṛtukālādhikaraṇakabhāryakarmakasvakartṛkagamanābhāvābhāvaḥ preramāviṣaya iti bodhe evārthaviśeṣyake pratyayānāmiti vyutpattibhaṅgaḥ, prāguktadoṣākrāntatvaṃ cetyata āha- ṛtāviti| svapadaṃ spaṣṭārtham| svamupagamanam|
analyzed: pṛthivī tva sāmānādhikaraṇyena ityādiḥ para mate ṛtau iti atra ṛtu kāla adhikaraṇaka bhāryā karmaka sva kartṛka gamana abhāva abhāvaḥ preramā viṣayaḥ iti bodhe eva artha viśeṣyake pratyayānām iti vyutpatti bhaṅgaḥ prāgukta doṣa ākrāntatvam ca iti atas āha ṛtau iti sva padam spaṣṭārtham svam upagamanam

original: tadanāśrayatvena gṛhītakarttṛkāraketyarthaḥ| - svabhāryeti| svakarttṛkamityapi bodhyam| - tasya-- upagamanasya| nanu tasya tattve eva kiṃ mānamata āha - iṣṭasyeti| sannidhau sthite iti śeṣaḥ| - tena--agamane doṣaśravaṇena| ata ekaṛtau gamane'pi ṛtvantare pratyavāyaparihārārthaṃ pravṛttiḥ|
analyzed: tad anāśraya tvena gṛhīta karttṛ kārakā iti arthaḥ sva bhāryā iti sva karttṛkam iti api bodhyam tasya upagamanasya nanu tasya tattve eva kim mānam atas āha iṣṭasya iti sannidhau sthite iti śeṣaḥ tena agamane doṣa śravaṇena atas eka ṛtau gamane api ṛtu antare pratyavāya parihāra artham pravṛttiḥ

original: evaṃ ca ṛtukālikaviśeṣaṇatayā bhāryākarmakagamanābhāvaḥ kartṛtāsambandhena svaniṣṭhaḥ pratyavāyasādhanamiti bodhyam| nanvevamavadhāraṇānāṃ nānātvena tadvadanekaśaktikalpanāpattiratrāpītyata āha - sakaleti| prāguktarītyaiva tatsiddhiḥ| paramatenāha - akhaṇḍopeti|
analyzed: evam ca ṛtukālika viśeṣaṇatayā bhāryā karmaka gamana abhāvaḥ kartṛ tā sambandhena sva niṣṭhaḥ pratyavāya sādhanam iti bodhyam nanu evam avadhāraṇānām nānātvena tadvat aneka śakti kalpanā āpattiḥ atra api iti atas āha sakala iti prāgukta rītyā eva tad siddhiḥ paramatena āha akhaṇḍa upeti

original: evāghaṭitaparisaṃkhyedāharaṇe'pi tatraivasamabhivyāhāre tathaiva bodhāt evamevetyāha - pañcapañceti| ityādāvapītyarthaḥ| atiprasaktatvāditaratvāvacchedāyāha - buddhistheti| ubhayaṃ pañcatvaviśeṣaṇam| tadrūpasaṃkhyetyarthaḥ| svaṃ tādṛśapañcatvam|
analyzed: eva a ghaṭita parisaṃkhyā idam āharaṇe api tatra eva samabhivyāhāre tathā eva bodhāt evam eva iti āha pañca pañca iti ityādau api iti arthaḥ atiprasaktatvāt itaratva avacchedāya āha buddhi sthā iti ubhayam pañcatva viśeṣaṇam tad rūpa saṃkhyā iti arthaḥ svam tādṛśa pañcatvam

original: tadasambandhi yad bhakṣyatvaṃ tadvān yaḥ pañcapañcanakhasamabhivyāhṛtabhakṣyapadārthastatprakāraketyarthaḥ| nanvitasteṣāmarthatastattvalābhe'pi rāgataḥ prāptasya na nivṛttiriti tat syādevetyaniṣṭamevāta āha - eveti| tatprayoge idam| tadabhāva āha - lakṣaṇeti| prāpakapramāṇaṃ rāgaḥ| - bodhitasyabhakṣaṇasya| - tadatirikteti|
analyzed: tad asambandhi yat bhakṣya tvam tadvān yaḥ pañca pañcanakha samabhivyāhṛta bhakṣya padārthaḥ tad prakāraka iti arthaḥ nanu itas teṣām arthataḥ tattva lābhe pi rāgataḥ prāptasya na nivṛttiḥ iti tat syāt eva iti aniṣṭam eva atas āha eva iti tad prayoge idam tad abhāve āha lakṣaṇā iti prāpaka pramāṇam rāgaḥ bodhitasya bhakṣaṇasya tad atiriktā iti

original: tādṛśapañcapañcanakhānyetyarthaḥ| anyathā'dṛṣṭārthamapūrvavidhau tadakaraṇe prāyaścittāpattiranuktānyabhakṣaṇe taduktyasāṅgatyāpattiśceti bhāvastadāha - iṣṭeti|| 1.43||
analyzed: tādṛśa pañca pañcanakhāni etyarthaḥ anyathā dṛṣṭārtham apūrva vidhau tad akaraṇe prāyaścitta āpattiḥ anukta anya bhakṣaṇe tad ukti asāṅgatya āpattiḥ ca iti bhāvaḥ tat āha iṣṭa iti 143

original: navyanaiyāyikoktiṅkhaṇḍayati - yattviti| sarvatreti śeṣaḥ| - vyavacchedaḥ-- sa eva| tena tadubhayavyavāvṛttiriti nānekaśaktikalpanaṃ tadvan| anyayogaścānyasambhandhamātram|
analyzed: navya naiyāyika uktiṅ khaṇḍayati yat tu iti sarvatra iti śeṣaḥ vyavacchedaḥ saḥ eva tena tad ubhaya vyava āvṛttiḥ iti na aneka śakti kalpanam tadvan anya yogaḥ ca anya sambhandha mātram

original: evaṃ ca nīlaṃ sarojamityādau ākhyātasyāśraye lakṣaṇayā nīlabhavanavadanyatvavyavacchedaḥ sarojatvasāmānādhikaraṇyena pratīyate, śaṅkhaḥ pāṇḍura evetyādau śaṅkhatvāvacchedena pāṇḍurānyatvavyavacchedabodhaḥ| pārtha evetyādau dhanurdharvāvacchedene pārthānyatvavyavacchedabodhaḥ| ṛtāvityatra tādṛśagamanavadanyatvavyavacchedabodhaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca nīlam sarojam ityādau ākhyātasya āśraye lakṣaṇayā nīla bhavana vat anyatva vyavacchedaḥ saroja tva sāmānādhikaraṇyena pratīyate śaṅkhaḥ pāṇḍuraḥ eva ityādau śaṅkha tva avacchedena pāṇḍura anyatva vyavaccheda bodhaḥ pārthaḥ eva ityādau pārtha anyatva vyavaccheda bodhaḥ ṛtau iti atra tādṛśa gamana vat anyatva vyavaccheda bodhaḥ

original: pṛthivyāmityādau pṛthivyanyavṛttitvavyavacchedabodho gandhādāviti tadākūtam| tadāha - pṛthivyāmiti| - gandheceti| ata eva pṛthivyāmevākāśa iti na, tasyāvṛttittavāt | yatpadasamabhivyāhāreṇa yaḥ sambandhaḥ pratīyate evasamabhivyāhārepi tasyaivānyayogasya vyavacchedadhīriti na doṣaḥ|
analyzed: pṛthivyām ityādau pṛthivī anya vṛttitva vyavaccheda bodhaḥ gandha ādau iti tad ākūtam tat āha pṛthivyām iti gandhe ca iti atas eva pṛthivyām eva ākāśaḥ iti na tasya avṛtti tta vāt yad pada samabhivyāhāreṇa yaḥ sambandhaḥ pratīyate eva samabhivyāhāre api tasya eva anya yogasya vyavaccheda dhīḥ iti na doṣaḥ

original: nanu saptamyarthaviśeṣaṇatayopasthitapṛthivyāḥ kathamevārthānyatve'nvayaḥ ekaviśeṣaṇatvenopasthitasyānyatrānvayasyāvyutpannatvādata āha - vibhaktiti| evasthale tad‌vyutpāttisaṅkoca iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu saptamī artha viśeṣaṇatayā upasthita pṛthivyāḥ katham eva artha anyatva invayaḥ eka viśeṣaṇatvena upasthitasya anyatra anvayasya avyutpanna tvāt atas āha vibhakti ti eva sthale tad vyutpātti saṅkocaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: pracīnamate tu nāyam evasya dyotakatvena pṛthivyanyatādātmyabhāvavato lakṣaṇayā pṛthivīpadārthatvena saptamyāḥ sādhutvārthakatvena pṛthivyanyatādātmyābhāvavad‌vṛttirgandha iti bodhenaivopapatteḥ| etadarthabhiyā'syollekhaḥ evārthabalādeva| samabhivyāhṛtapadārthatāvacchedakāvacchedena pṛthivyanyatadātmyābhāvavad‌vṛttirgandha iti bodhenaivopapatteḥ|
analyzed: pracīna mate tu na ayam dyotaka tvena pṛthivī anya tādātmya bhāvavataḥ lakṣaṇayā pṛthivī padārtha tvena saptamyāḥ sādhutva arthaka tvena pṛthivī anya tādātmya abhāvavat vṛttiḥ gandhaḥ iti bodhena eva upapatteḥ etad artha bhiyā asya ullekhaḥ eva artha balāt eva samabhivyāhṛta padārtha tā avacchedaka avacchedena pṛthivī anya tad ātmya abhāvavat vṛttiḥ gandhaḥ iti bodhena eva upapatteḥ

original: etadarthabhiyā'syellekhaḥ evārthabalādeva| samabhivyāhṛtapadārthatāvacchedakāvacchedena tad‌vṛttitvasya bodhānna pṛthivīvṛttyeveti tu bhavetyevoktarītyeti bodhyam| prācīnamatasādhārāṇaṃ doṣamāha - aneketi| - tatra-- prācīnamate| śīta evetyādau yathā tat tathoktam|
analyzed: etad artha bhiyāsyet lekhaḥ eva artha balāt eva samabhivyāhṛta padārtha tā avacchedaka avacchedena tad vṛtti tvasya bodhāt na pṛthivī vṛtti eva iti tu bhava iti eva ukta rītyā iti bodhyam prācīna mata sādhārāṇam doṣam āha aneka iti tatra prācīna mate śītaḥ eva ityādau yathā tat tathā uktam

original: pārtha evetyādau dhanurdharābhinnaḥ pārthānyātādātmyābhāvavāniti bodhena navyamatoktavyutpattivaicitryam| śaṅke pāṇḍaratvamevetyādāvapvevaṃ pāṇḍaratvānvatādātmyabhāvavacchaṃnnavṛttiti bodhāt|
analyzed: pārthaḥ eva ityādau dhanurdharā bhinnaḥ pārtha anya a tādātmya abhāvavān iti bodhena navya mata ukta vyutpatti vaicitryam śaṅke pāṇḍara tvam eva ityādau apu evam bodhāt

original: śaṅkhaḥ pāṇḍura evetyādāvapi śaṅkhatvāvacchedena pāṇḍuratādātmyābhāvavān śaṅkha iti bodhena, evaṃ nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyevetyādau tu ukta eva bodha iti tat mphuṭameva| evamubhayamate'pi anyayogavyavecchedādau anyādiṃṣu bhinnaśaktābadhikagauravam, viśiṣṭaśaktāvapyevam|
analyzed: śaṅkhaḥ pāṇḍuraḥ eva ityādau api śaṅkha tva avacchedena pāṇḍura tādātmya abhāvavān śaṅkhaḥ iti bodhena evam nīlam sarojam bhavati eva ityādau tu uktaḥ eva bodhaḥ iti tat mphuṭam eva evam ubhaya mate pi anya yoga vyaveccheda ādau anya ādiṣu bhinna śaktau adhika gauravam viśiṣṭa śaktau api evam

original: ghaṭādanya ityādāvivaikadeśānvayo vyutpattivaicitryādekapadajopasthitiviṣayāṇāmanvayo'pi mitho vyutpattivaicitryādeveti bodhyam| etena vyavacchede śaktiranyatra lakṣaṇetyapi navyanaiyāyikoktamapāstam| sādhāraṇameva doṣāntaramāha - tādṛśaiti| nanu ghaṭānpaśyetyādivadatra prātipadikatantreṇa nirvāho'ta āha - vibhaktimiti|
analyzed: ghaṭāt anyaḥ ityādau iva eka deśa anvayaḥ vyutpatti vaicitryāt eka pada ja upasthiti viṣayāṇām anvayaḥ api mithas vyutpatti vaicitryāt eva iti bodhyam etena vyavacchede śaktiḥ anyatra lakṣaṇā iti api navya naiyāyika uktam apāstam sādhāraṇam eva doṣa antaram āha tādṛśa eti nanu ghaṭān paśya ityādi vat atra prātipadika tantreṇa āha vibhaktim iti

original: tatra sahavivakṣāviṣayatvena tatsattve'pyatrāsahavivakṣāviṣayatvena na tatheti bhāvaḥ| etanāvṛttiprayuktaṃ gauravamapyatra mate sūcitam| abhyupetyedam| vastuto'phalatvānnaiva setyāha - pṛthivīti| gandhe ityādiḥ| mānāntaraṃ pratyakṣam| tathācāvadhāraṇaviṣayapṛthivīvṛttitvavāngandha itayovoktarītyā bodhaḥ|
analyzed: tatra saha vivakṣā viṣaya tvena tad sattve pi atra asaha vivakṣā viṣaya tvena na tathā iti bhāvaḥ gauravam api atra mate sūcitam abhyupetya idam vastutas phalatvāt na eva sā iti āha pṛthivī iti gandhe ityādiḥ māna antaram pratyakṣam tathāca avadhāraṇa viṣaya pṛthivī vṛtti tvavān gandhaḥ bodhaḥ

original: avadhāraṇaṃ ca pṛthivāyanyāvṛttitvena gṛhītasamabhivyāhṛtagandhaviśeṣyakajñānarūpaṃ tat| evaddoṣacatuṣṭayena pārtha evetyādau pārtho dhanurdharaḥ pārthānyona dhanurdhara ityādirbodha ityapyupāstam| - ata eva-- tatra tasya tato labdhatvādeva| uktarītyā śābdatvāsambhavādāha - ārthyeveti| - evaṃ ca -- tasyārthatve ca |
analyzed: avadhāraṇam ca gṛhīta samabhivyāhṛta gandha viśeṣyaka jñāna rūpam tat evat doṣa catuṣṭayena pārthaḥ eva ityādau pārthaḥ dhanurdharaḥ dhanurdharaḥ ityādiḥ bodhaḥ iti api upāstam atas eva tatra tasya tatas labdhatvāt eva ukta rītyā śābdatva asambhavāt āha ārthī eva iti evam ca tasya artha tve ca

original: apinā tadasamabhivyāhṛtapañcetyasya samuccayaḥ| tatsvarūpamāha - sāceti| niṣedhaityarthaḥ| nanvevaṃ siddhānte śābdyucchedāpattiḥ | paramate tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, evāsattvāsattvākṣyaṃ tadvibhāgambhavādata āha - śābdītviti| - ityādau--ityādāveva| ādinā kiṃ bhūṣaṇamityādiḥ| apisamucceyamāha - pañceti| - atirikteti|
analyzed: apinā tad asamabhivyāhṛta pañca ityasya samuccayaḥ tad svarūpam āha sā ca iti niṣedhaḥ eti arthaḥ nanu evam siddhānte śābdī uccheda āpattiḥ para mate tu na ayam doṣaḥ eva asattva asattva akṣyam tad vibhāgambhavāt atas āha śābdī tu iti ityādau ityādau eva ādinā kim bhūṣaṇam iti ādiḥ api samucceyam āha pañca iti atirikta iti

original: prāptānuvādavaiyarthyana tasya tatra lakṣaṇayetyarthaḥ| nanvevābhāvetadarthaghaṭitalakṣaṇāyāmeva na mānamiti kathaṃ tathā parisaṃkhyā'ta āha - ata eveti| prāyeṇātra śāstre niyamapadena parisaṅkhyaivocyate iti bhāvaḥ| - tadabhāveti| tadabhāve'pi tathārthāṅgīkāreṇetyarthaḥ| tadevāha - tenahīti| bhāṣyavyākhyānenetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: prāpta anuvāda vaiyarthyana tasya tatra lakṣaṇayā iti arthaḥ nanu eva abhāva etad artha ghaṭita lakṣaṇāyām eva na mānam iti katham tathā parisaṃkhyātaḥ āha atas eva iti prāyeṇa atra śāstre niyama padena parisaṅkhyā eva ucyate iti bhāvaḥ tad abhāva iti tad abhāve api tathā artha aṅgīkāreṇa iti arthaḥ tat eva āha tena hi iti bhāṣya vyākhyānena iti arthaḥ

original: mīmāṃsakadharmaśāstrakārādayastu iyaṃ śābdī parisaṅkhyetyāhustanmataṃ khaṇḍayati - yattviti |' yuṣmadyupapade' ityādau doṣamāha - kiñceti| yata iti śeṣaḥ| - evam-- tadvad‌śābdītvasya tatrārthāpattau| niyamaśāstrasya niṣedhaparatvādāha - śāstrīyeti| - kimeti| kimekānte dhyeyaṃ caraṇayugalaṃ kaustubhabhṛtaḥ|
analyzed: mīmāṃsaka dharma śāstra kāra ādayaḥ tu iyam śābdī parisaṅkhyā iti āhuḥ tad matam khaṇḍayati yat tu iti yuṣmadi upapade ityādau doṣam āha kiñca iti yatas iti śeṣaḥ evam tadvat śābdī tvasya tatra arthāpattau niyama śāstrasya niṣedha paratvāt āha śāstrīyā iti kim eti kim ekānte dhyeyam caraṇa yugalam kaustubha bhṛtaḥ

original: kimārādhyam puṇyaṃ kimabhilaṣaṇīyañca karuṇā yadāsaktyā ceto niravadhi vimuktayai prabhavatīti etaccheṣaḥ| - ārtheti| praśnapūrvaketyādiḥ| evamagre'pi| ādinā pradīpādi| - ata eva --tasyā ārthatvādeva |- kimbhūṣaṇamiti|
analyzed: kim ārādhyam puṇyam kim abhilaṣaṇīyam ca karuṇā yad āsaktyā cetaḥ niravadhi vimuktayai prabhavati iti etad śeṣaḥ ārtha iti praśna pūrvakā ityādiḥ evam agre api ādinā pradīpa ādi atas eva tasyāḥ ārtha tvāt eva kim bhūṣaṇam iti

original: kiṃ kāryamāryacaritaṃ sukṛtaṃ na doṣaḥ| kiṃ cakṣurapratihataṃ dhiṣaṇā na netraṃ jānāti kastvadaparaḥ sadasaddhivekamiti etaccheṣaḥ| - udāhṛtamiti| prakāśakārādibhiriti bhāvaḥ| tatra bhāṣyavirodhamapi sūcayannāha - bhāṣyeti| - kṛtam-- iṣṭam| - itītītyatrāhetyasyānvayaḥ| - tatra-- tayormadhye| - taditi| tatprayogetyarthaḥ|
